text: Checkout builds a Cart, prices it with price_lines, then CartService::apply_discount applies the promotion rules. Discounts are never trusted from the client (see ADR 0007).
Discounts are computed server-side, never in the client
Discounts are computed server-side; client-side totals were tampered with in incident 2026-10-26; src/checkout/**; cart::CartService::apply_discount
A commit renames apply_discount to apply_promotion. The old anchor key is absent there, so the anchor is reported stale; the accepted Decision 0007 is untouched.
